packet.method: Procedural sealed inflated 5×5-sample pouch; generated label art on four padded atlas tiles, reduced from192triangles after dense-string budget review
packet.rejected: Direct decimation fragmented UV seams; welding alone preserved geometry but distorted the printed UV islands

bottle-crate.method: Regular closed beveled frame, lattice, floor and bottle dividers; authored UV patch reuses original color and PBR maps
bottle-crate.rejected: Generated source had nonmanifold, twisted wall panels

apple-pile.method: Weld seam positions before reducing each fruit; bake a24-fruit clump. Fit every tray and pile uniformly; use two crates on wide supports.

shop-materials.method: Generated worn hardwood and scuffed plastic albedos; directional UV mapping, shared atlas tiles, derived low-strength normal and roughness maps.

dry-goods-bag.method: Reuse source rice-sack mesh, uniformly fit and reduce for repeated shelf goods; retain UVs and neutral cloth/contents with printed label variants

stock-box.method: Regular closed shipping-box shell with generated printed labels and replicated atlas gutters

stock-appearances.method: Eight generated label designs projected onto front UV islands, four appearances per eligible asset; copy matching normal/property maps; reuse seven spare atlas tiles and no extra PBR materials
